scope: Programmer behavior tests using actual staged modules and controlled canvas/media I/O; not a browser/user or physical font/audio test.

checks.name: Centered reference-sized controls scale without false Fixed-mode advice; ignored Fixed breakpoints are diagnosed
Partial stretch anchors independently resolve both axes and inset offsets
Anchor presets remain compatible with default .5 metadata and custom anchors override presets
Hidden/disabled ancestors suppress render, hit testing and accessibility descendants
Cyclic and over-depth hierarchy fails visibly without hanging or partial descendants
Fixed pixels, responsive scale, breakpoints and safe area use the same geometry
Container fixed preferred sizes, Fill allocation and alignment/justification are applied
Wrapped Flow uses authored widths, line breaks and spacing deterministically
RTL mirrors asymmetric child geometry once, preserving dimensions
Clipping and scrolling share hit-test and visible-area bounds
Runtime and responsive matrix expose exactly identical actual rectangles
Measured text wraps without squeeze and ellipsis respects width and height
Unicode limits do not create broken surrogate pairs and segmentation preserves composition glyphs
Actual renderer never supplies Canvas fillText maxWidth for authored Text
Checkbox requires pointer release inside; cancellation and outside release remain inert
Repeated focus and repeat keydown cannot repeat activation callbacks
Modal focus excludes background controls while disabled controls retain semantics
Keyboard text focus creates native-input ownership and commits values atomically
Child theme omission preserves parent tokens, variables and every state
Grouped and chained tokens resolve; cycles and invalid numbers are not applied
Multi-hop locale fallback and Canvas locale override resolve actual text and direction
Pseudolocalization also audits literal fallback text and locale cache invalidates with assets
Font fallback references follow all locale fallback tables
Native bridge defers composition commits and preserves selection during synchronization
Shared captions pause, expire at the half-open boundary and clear on disposal
CSV retains multiline strings, quote escapes and all variants; malformed imports refuse
PO preserves multiline strings and Nova variant metadata; unsupported indexed imports refuse
Invalid locale/theme saves retain the exact previous asset and settings
Localization extraction reads live component Maps and ignores commented script calls
Theme/localization session drafts participate in project departure and explicit discard
Slider pointer and keyboard emit changed-value callbacks once and clamp repeat input
Explicit RTL preview, actual Content width and z-order remain effective for crowded scenes
Duplicate and invalid locale creation refuses before changing asset identity or count
Bounded key extraction reports incomplete coverage rather than a clean empty audit
Native input retains authored 100k limit while preserving astral composition boundaries
Saving an edited sparse child theme preserves future parent typography/tokens/states
Actual input collector ignores editor controls/composition and releases held keys on focus transfer
Negative tab index permits deliberate focus but skips sequential traversal; positive order precedes automatic
Reading order, state description and ProgressBar range reach the actual accessibility mirror
Rounded mask corners cannot hit clipped child controls
